title: They work
text: They work. I bought these to cover my upholstered kitchen stools. They’re SLIGHTLY too small. I’m happy that they aren’t too big but the area where the seat meets the back kind of stretches up a little instead of tucking in. Not too big a deal because they still protect the chair.
